meta.title: Evomon monster dex

sources.label: Evomon community dex (evomon.org Monster Wiki)
sources.usage: Primary roster, dex number, element(s), evolution stage, evolution line, base stats, BST, catch location, and per-creature art.

sources.label: Pro Game Guides - Evomon beginner & progression guides
sources.usage: Cross-check of starters, elements, and catch zones (Verdant Valley, Petal Pond, Lava Crag, Amber Acres).

sources.label: Gamezebo - Evomon best starter
sources.usage: Cross-check of starter Evomon (Bubble, Blazpup, Leafbun) and element matchups.

sources.label: Nerdschalk - Evomon guides
sources.usage: Cross-check of specific evolution lines (Pummpaw to Pummash) and mechanics.

notes: Base stats, BST, evolution lines, and catch locations are community/fan-measured from evomon.org, not official Roblox data; render with caveats and never present as official.

evomon.org flags most entries with staff 'Undiscovered Evomon' boilerplate text, but the structured element, stat, stage, and evolution fields are populated. The placeholder flag is captured in dataStatus; values are kept as-is.
Only 17 of 75 entries list a specific catch location in the source; the remaining 58 are left blank (renderer shows '-') rather than invented.
Section field is primary element. Dual-typed Evomon (e.g. Bug / Poison) are placed by their primary (first) element, which matches the source element distribution totalling 75.
Dex numbers include gaps above 75 (some numbered slots are unreleased/unrevealed and intentionally excluded from this 75-creature catalogued set).
